page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re8.60xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features dedicated Intel Xeon 8490H processors operating at a base clock speed of 1.9 GHz, delivering a total of 240 dedicated vCPUs. This instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads, providing 4096.0 GB of RAM, which translates to approximately 17.07 GB of memory per vCPU core.

The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between the instance and external storage or network resources.

Given the massive memory capacity and high vCPU count, this instance is optimized for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, massive data caching layers, and heavy memory-bound analytics workloads. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that require vast amounts of RAM without needing proportional scaling of compute resources.
